conditions.engine: MuJoCo WebAssembly (@mujoco/mujoco) in Node, timestep 2 ms; probes in tests/measure/patch-probes.ts on tests/measure/gravity-harness.ts
conditions.request: chat.completions, response_format json_object, temperature left at the model default (not sent), no streaming; thinking off = chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking false; thinking on = default reasoning with max_tokens 4096 covering reasoning and answer; up to 2 retries on network errors, 429 and 5xx
conditions.loop: iteration 0 = the probe's naive program; on a fail the patcher gets the task, the world line, the knobs with bounds and meaning, one line per earlier attempt (knobs or patch, and the check line of its note) and the last failure note; its "set" is validated and clamped (patch-probes.ts applyPatch); at most 5 patches; a failed or unparseable call counts as a patch that changes nothing
conditions.world_line: the patcher is told the gravity; hand-off velocity, offsets and vehicle bursts reach it only through measurements in the failure note
conditions.expert_check: each case/seed also runs a hand-written expert program; a case whose expert fails is reported as unsolvable with these knobs
conditions.seeds: per arm, in each arm's config
conditions.round_2: arms named r2-*: the next patch prompt says when a requested value was clamped to a bound or rejected; escalation arms switch patcher after a no-op patch (re-asked at once) or after the base patcher's second failed patch; ledger script patch-loop-r2 with its own cap
conditions.liquid: pour-liquid: lib/sim/fluid.ts position-based liquid, 600 particles at 4 mm (38 mL), one-way coupled to the MuJoCo cups via lib/sim/fluid-mujoco.ts, 60 frames/s with the solver's defaults
conditions.comparators: arms named cmp-* (issue #96): the round-2 loop, prompts, cases and seeds of r2-super-off and r2-super-on with a non-NVIDIA model from Token Factory as the patcher; its reasoning switched as in scripts/compare-models.mjs (prices from tests/fixtures/models-compare.json); ledger script compare-patch under the study's cap; each arm's config records its concurrency
